explanation: The two-job execution contains an upstream fault. The top-level corpus supplied to job_1 includes eight demand records, including n06-r01 with demand_score 9, but job_1 output silently omits n06-r01 from both needs and evidence_sources and reports only seven records. Job_2 appears to preserve the two handoffs it actually received and ranks unsupported needs first, so the visible fault is localized to job_1. The supplied evidence does not identify a specific function.
cited_evidence: job_1 input corpus includes record_id n06-r01 with need "isolate faulty execution branches before replay", demand_score 9, source_id s01, source_weight 5.
job_1 output needs begins at n06-r02 and contains only n06-r02 through n06-r08; n06-r01 is absent.
job_1 output evidence_sources likewise contains ranks 1-7 for n06-r02 through n06-r08 and omits n06-r01.
job_1 metadata reports evidence_source_count 7 and record_count 7 despite the supplied corpus containing 8 records.
job_2 input consumes the exact job_1 handoffs, needs and evidence_sources, both already missing n06-r01.
